pages.title: Better Horses
pages.text: Better Horses turns an ordinary mount into a lasting companion - ownership, bonding, fifteen breeds, dedicated gear, and a stack of riding fixes. This handbook covers all of it.

pages.title: It's Yours
pages.text: Tame a horse and it's registered to you right away. From there you can bond with it, equip it, and give it commands.

pages.title: Where to Start
pages.text:
New here? Begin with **Claiming a Mount**. The **Tack Room** lists every craft and **Breeds** is a field guide to all fifteen.

Back here in **Barn Door Basics**, **The Horse Roster** finds a mount you've mislaid and **Trusted Riders** lends one to a friend. **Traits at a Glance** and **Breeding Rules** cover bloodlines, while **Trail Tricks** and **Mounted Comforts** collect the riding improvements.
